Subject: Staggered conference-window proposal for multi-role demo

Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical walkthrough next week. To keep scope narrow and make the sessions useful for each stakeholder (eng, procurement, security), I want to propose a repeating set of 90–120 minute windows we can rotate across US / EU / APAC so we capture overlap without burning any single team overnight.

Quick proposal:
- Week A (Mon/Wed): 08:00–10:00 PT (16:00–18:00 CEST) — APAC-friendly follow-up slot
- Week B (Tue/Thu): 13:00–15:00 PT (21:00–23:00 CEST) — Europe-first window with late APAC overlap
- Week C (Wed/Fri): 22:00–00:00 PT (06:00–08:00 CEST next day) — APAC morning / US late

Advantages: rotates inconvenience, gives predictable handoff windows for SEs and AEs, and creates a standing procurement/security slot every other week so we can feed questions into the action tracker.

Action items:
1) Can you confirm which roles should be present in the first session (engineering, procurement, security)?
2) Any blackout dates next two weeks?
3) I attached a simple overlap matrix (overlap-matrix.xlsx) — update it if you want different offsets.

If those high-level blocks look OK I’ll have Marissa spin up a calendar poll and we’ll lock the first three sessions.

—Markus
Markus Klein
